name: Dreadwake hits an enemy 28.6 degrees off the Reaper's facing (#5353)
contract: Every Dreadwake rank (803992, 503286-503289, 503324, 503531) targets TARGET_UNIT_CONE_ENEMY_24 with a 12 yd
radius. Without a spell_cone row the core read the enum suffix as 24 degrees (+/-12), so the 'wave of souls'
missed enemies plainly in front of the Reaper. The first-rank spell_cone row restores the core's former 90
degrees for the whole chain, as for Flames of Xoroth. Fixture: orientation 0.5 with the golem 3 yd along +X,
28.6 degrees off the facing - inside 90, outside 24. Expected: rank 7 damages the golem once.

steps.label: Let the weapon swap cooldown expire
Rank 7 hits the golem 28.6 degrees off the facing
